title: Layering a well-formed circuit
statement: Let $C$ be a directed acyclic circuit with $n$ inputs, and suppose each gate has distinct input nodes and every NOT gate has exactly one input. Its associated layered circuit has depth one more than the number of gates, input type $	ext{Fin}\,n$, and singleton output type; its layers and gates are those determined by $C$.
hypotheses_covered: C is a DAG circuit with n inputs
Each gate's input list has no repetitions
Each NOT gate has exactly one input
